Alex 	6 thanks for the questions and for sending the VSA. Quick answers and what we can provide:  

SOC 2:
- Current status: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type I in 2024 and is targeting Type II (in-scope for inference control plane & data handling) with an expected report date of Q3 2026.
- We can provide SOC 2 Type I report and the associated controls matrix now for your review.

GDPR / HIPAA:
- GDPR: we support standard DSAR workflows; deletion requests propagate to our storage backends within 30 days by policy and we provide export/delete APIs for customers. We will include the data flow diagram and retention table in the security pack.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood supports BAA for customers that require it. For vendor-scoped usage (inference-only for a specific product), we're open to executing a BAA once we confirm scoping and hosting model (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

Pen Test + NDA:
- We can provide the full pen test report under NDA. We've attached the redacted pen test report in this thread and can escalate the full report once the NDA is in place.  
- DocuSign NDA: https://www.docusign.net/xxxx-pen-test-nda

Vulnerability management & SLAs (summary):
- Scanning cadence: weekly authenticated scans for infra + monthly agent-based scanning for container images.
- Remediation SLA: Critical (CVSS >= 9.0): 72 hours median time-to-remediate for infra; High (7.0-8.9): 14 days; Medium/Low: prioritized by risk and exposure.
- Disclosure policy: We follow a 90-day coordinated disclosure window with customers and vendors (exceptions for active exploitation where we may accelerate public disclosure). Full policy attached: Vulnerability_Management_Policy.pdf.
- Evidence: We can provide Jira tickets and remediation timelines for sample CVEs on request.

Next steps from our side:
1) Marissa 	6 please confirm receipt of the VSA and we will assign owners to each section.
2) Alex/Sam 	6 if you sign the NDA link above, I will have legal send the full pen test report to sam.olson@pentestlab.com and security@fintechco.com.
3) We can schedule a 30-min technical review next week (suggest Tue/Wed mornings PST).

Happy to jump on a call to walk through the vuln SLA and evidence.

Regards,
